audit_metadata.grade_rationale: 4 P1 findings exceed C-grade maximum of 2. F reserved for confirmed auth bypass + critical domain failure — not applicable here.
audit_metadata.skip_reason: Services offline — backend at http://localhost:3001 and frontend at http://localhost:5173 not reachable; static analysis only

escalations.title: Handlebars JavaScript Injection RCE
escalations.description: Handlebars <=4.7.8 allows arbitrary JavaScript injection via AST Type Confusion. RCE vector if any Handlebars templates evaluate untrusted input.

escalations.title: esbuild Binary Integrity — Supply Chain RCE
escalations.description: esbuild <0.28.1 downloads platform binaries without checksum verification. A compromised registry or MITM can inject malicious binaries into CI/CD build pipelines. BLOCKS RELEASES.
escalations.fix: npm install vite@^8.0.16 across all Frontend workspaces; npm install tsx@latest in portal/Backend

escalations.title: vitest Critical Vulnerabilities (cascading esbuild/vite)
escalations.description: vitest ^1.4.0 in portal/Frontend pulls vulnerable vite and esbuild versions (see DEP-002). Cascading critical vulnerability from esbuild supply chain.

p1_findings.title: Traceability Enforcer Blind Spot — portal/ Not Scanned
p1_findings.description: The verification gate scans only Source/ and E2E/. The primary production app (portal/) with FR-001…FR-069 is invisible. Creates false passes on the default CI gate and false failures when run against dev-workflow-platform.md.
p1_findings.exploit_scenario: CI gate always passes regardless of portal/ traceability regression. Developers ship code without traceability and it is never caught.
p1_findings.impact: CI gate provides false confidence. All portal/ spec drift goes undetected.
p1_findings.recommendation: Add portal/ to scan paths in tools/traceability-enforcer.py line 71: source_dirs = ["Source", "E2E", "portal"]

p1_findings.title: Handlebars JavaScript Injection RCE
p1_findings.description: Handlebars <=4.7.8 JavaScript injection via AST Type Confusion. CVSS 9.8 — full RCE if templates evaluate untrusted input.
p1_findings.exploit_scenario: Attacker submits crafted Handlebars template via any endpoint that passes user input to Handlebars.compile(). Executes arbitrary code on server.
p1_findings.impact: Remote Code Execution on backend services.
p1_findings.recommendation: npm audit fix to upgrade handlebars to >=4.7.9

p1_findings.title: esbuild Binary Integrity — Supply Chain RCE
p1_findings.description: esbuild <0.28.1 downloads platform-specific binaries via npm_config_registry without integrity verification. Compromised registry or MITM injects malicious binaries into build pipeline.
p1_findings.exploit_scenario: Attacker controls a package mirror or intercepts npm traffic during CI. Injects trojanized esbuild binary. All subsequent builds execute attacker code.
p1_findings.impact: Supply chain compromise. Every production build and developer machine building the project is at risk. BLOCKS RELEASES.
p1_findings.recommendation: Upgrade vite to ^8.0.16 across all Frontend workspaces. Upgrade tsx to latest in portal/Backend.

p1_findings.title: vitest Critical Vulnerabilities (cascading esbuild/vite)
p1_findings.description: vitest ^1.4.0 transitively pulls in vulnerable vite and esbuild versions, inheriting the esbuild supply chain risk (DEP-002).
p1_findings.exploit_scenario: Same as DEP-002 — vitest is a devDependency but shares the build-time attack surface.
p1_findings.impact: Cascading P1 from esbuild vulnerability. Test pipeline attack surface.

p2_findings.title: Direct SQL in Route Handler — teamDispatches.ts
p2_findings.description: Raw db.prepare().all()/.run() SQL inline in GET and POST route handlers. No service layer. No traceability comments.
p2_findings.recommendation: Extract teamDispatchService.ts with listDispatches() and recordDispatch() functions. Route handlers call service layer only.

p2_findings.title: inspector.config.yml Missing portal/ in Source Dirs
p2_findings.description: source.dirs lists only Source/. The primary production app portal/ with 50+ routes and SQLite is invisible to all inspector specialists. Specifications/Implementation/ referenced but non-existent.
p2_findings.recommendation: Add portal/ to source.dirs and portal/Backend/tests/, portal/Frontend/tests/ to test_dirs. Remove or create Specifications/Implementation/.

p2_findings.title: Traceability ID Mismatch — FR-dependency-linking vs FR-dependency-search
p2_findings.description: File uses // Verifies: FR-dependency-linking which is not a valid spec ID. Correct ID is FR-dependency-search. Enforcer would flag FR-dependency-search as unimplemented.

p2_findings.title: Untraced Unspecced Production Files (3 files)
p2_findings.description: Three production files modified in the initial commit with zero // Verifies: comments and no corresponding spec requirement. TeamsPage.tsx (406 lines) implements a Teams UI with no FR in dev-workflow-platform.md — scope creep.
p2_findings.recommendation: Create spec requirement for teams/dispatch-history feature, or map to existing FR. Add traceability comments.

p2_findings.title: path-to-regexp Open Redirect
p2_findings.description: Vulnerability in route path parsing allows crafted routes for open redirect attacks.
p2_findings.recommendation: npm audit fix in platform/orchestrator and portal/Backend

p2_findings.title: gaxios SSRF + joi Validation Bypass
p2_findings.description: gaxios (via OpenTelemetry) doesn't validate URLs properly — SSRF vector. Joi validation bypass via transitive OpenTelemetry dependency.

p2_findings.title: Joi Input Validation Bypass
p2_findings.description: Joi schema validation can be bypassed via transitive OpenTelemetry dependency chain.

p2_findings.title: postcss XSS via Unescaped </style> (HIGH in SPA context)
p2_findings.description: PostCSS <8.5.10 doesn't escape </style> tags in stringify output, enabling CSS-in-JS XSS in SPA context.

p2_findings.title: esbuild Path Traversal in Dev Server
p2_findings.description: Vite dev server vulnerable to path traversal in optimized deps .map handling. Dev-environment risk for all frontend workspaces.
p2_findings.recommendation: Upgrade vite to >=6.4.2 or >=8.0.16 (covered by DEP-002 fix)

p3_findings.title: Traceability Enforcer — False Positives from Seed Data / Template Placeholders
p3_findings.description: Regex FR-[A-Z0-9-]+ matches seed data IDs (FR-0002), template placeholders (FR-XXX) producing noisy false positives.
p3_findings.recommendation: Filter out: IDs matching FR-0\d{3}$, and placeholders FR-XXX/FR-XXXX from extract_fr_ids()

p3_findings.title: Two Service Files Exceed 500-Line Threshold
p3_findings.description: Both services exceed the 500-line guideline, accumulating mixed concerns and making targeted changes risky.
p3_findings.recommendation: Split cycleService.ts into lifecycle/ticket/cicd layers. Check featureRequestService.ts for duplication with existing votingService.ts.

p3_findings.title: eslint-disable Suppressions Masking Hook Dependency Issues
p3_findings.description: 3 react-hooks/exhaustive-deps suppressions in useEffect/useCallback without explanatory comments. May mask stale closure bugs.
p3_findings.recommendation: Add comment explaining intentional omission, or add missing dependency.

p3_findings.title: body-parser & qs Query String Parsing Vulnerabilities
p3_findings.description: Multiple qs parsing vulnerabilities, prototype pollution risk. Transitive via express.
p3_findings.recommendation: npm audit fix (updates qs via express 5.x upgrade)

p3_findings.title: brace-expansion Zero-Step Sequence DoS
p3_findings.description: brace-expansion allows crafted zero-step sequence causing process hang and memory exhaustion (CWE-400).

p3_findings.title: react-router-dom Open Redirect
p3_findings.description: react-router-dom 6.7.0-6.30.3 allows open redirect when path starts with //. Current version 6.26.0 is vulnerable.

p3_findings.title: 6 Packages Multiple Major Versions Behind
p3_findings.description: 6 packages are 1-5 major versions behind latest. Express 4.x has known CVEs; upgrade to 5.x is a breaking change requiring planning.
p3_findings.recommendation: Plan express 4.x → 5.x migration. Schedule react 18→19 upgrade. Apply react-router-dom patch as part of DEP-011 fix.

p4_findings.title: FR-TMP-001…FR-TMP-010 Untraced — Tiered Merge Pipeline Spec
p4_findings.description: 10 requirements for the tiered merge pipeline are untraced anywhere in Source/ or portal/. Likely platform-layer but not scoped out in config.
p4_findings.recommendation: Add note to inspector.config.yml scoping FR-TMP-* as platform-layer out-of-band, or create corresponding plan.

p4_findings.title: Silent OTel Init Failure — No Warning Log
p4_findings.description: Catch block documents non-fatal intent but emits no warning. Operators have no signal that OTel failed to initialize.
p4_findings.recommendation: Add: logger.warn({ msg: 'OTel SDK init failed — running without distributed tracing', error: err.message })

p4_findings.title: prom-client Satisfactory (Patch Only)
p4_findings.description: prom-client 15.1.0 is current within major version — only patch updates available. No action required.
